effects.label: Panic
effects.desc: Bonuses on the unit are converted into penalties.

effects.label: Exposure
effects.desc: Foe's attacks deal +10 damage.

effects.label: Discord
effects.desc: Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-X during combat (grows with nearby allies).

effects.label: Sabotage
effects.desc: Inflicts penalties equal to the highest penalty nearby.

effects.label: Undefended
effects.desc: The target cannot be protected by Savior.

effects.label: Isolation
effects.desc: The target cannot use or be targeted by Assist skills.

effects.label: Gravity
effects.desc: Restricts the target's movement to 1 space.

effects.label: Stall
effects.desc: Neutralises "unit can move 1 extra space" effects on the target.

effects.label: Frozen
effects.desc: Worsens the target's follow-up ability and improves the foe's.

effects.label: Deep Wounds
effects.desc: The target's HP cannot be healed.

effects.label: Feud
effects.desc: Disables all ally skills (excluding the unit's) during combat.

effects.label: Schism
effects.desc: Neutralises Triangle Attack, Dual Strike and Pathfinder on the unit.

effects.label: En Garde
effects.desc: Neutralises out-of-combat damage (except area-of-effect Specials).

effects.label: Null Panic
effects.desc: Blocks Panic's bonus-to-penalty conversion.

effects.label: Drain Cancel
effects.desc: Blocks bonus-stealing effects such as Essence Drain.

effects.label: Canto Control
effects.desc: Limits how far the target can move with Canto.

effects.label: Ploy
effects.desc: Neutralises Bonus Doubler, Treachery and Grand Strategy on the target.

effects.label: Divine Vein
effects.desc: Applies a terrain/space effect such as Flame, Ice or Stone.

effects.label: Hexblade
effects.desc: Damage is calculated with the lower of the foe's Def or Res.

effects.label: Empathy
effects.desc: Bonus scaling driven by the types of Bonus/Penalty effects in play.

effects.label: Anathema
effects.desc: Inflicts Spd/Def/Res-4 on foes within 3 spaces during combat.

effects.label: Canto
effects.desc: The unit can move again after acting (range varies by Canto type).

effects.label: Pathfinder
effects.desc: Allies treat the unit's space as 0 movement.

effects.label: Charge
effects.desc: Grants Warp-style movement up to 3 spaces.

effects.label: Savior
effects.desc: Takes an ally's space and enters combat in their place.

effects.label: Bulwark
effects.desc: Blocks nearby foes from moving through adjacent spaces.

effects.label: Null Follow-Up
effects.desc: Neutralises effects that guarantee the foe's or prevent the unit's follow-up.

effects.label: Guaranteed follow-up
effects.desc: The unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.

effects.label: Follow-up denial
effects.desc: Prevents the foe from making a follow-up attack.

effects.label: Desperation
effects.desc: The unit's follow-up lands before the foe can counterattack.

effects.label: Vantage
effects.desc: The unit counterattacks before the foe's first attack.

effects.label: Null C-Disrupt
effects.desc: Neutralises effects that prevent the unit's counterattacks.

effects.label: Sweep
effects.desc: The foe cannot counterattack at all.

effects.label: Brave attack
effects.desc: The unit attacks twice when initiating.

effects.label: Spd Preempt
effects.desc: Counterattacks before the foe's first attack when faster.

effects.label: Potent Follow
effects.desc: Extra follow-up strike that deals a share of normal damage.

effects.label: Preempt Pulse
effects.desc: Grants cooldown count-1 before the unit's first attack.

effects.label: Special charge +1
effects.desc: Grants Special cooldown charge +1 per attack.

effects.label: Special jump
effects.desc: Grants Special cooldown count-X outright.

effects.label: Tempo
effects.desc: Neutralises "Special cooldown charge -X" effects on the unit.

effects.label: Guard
effects.desc: Inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on the foe.

effects.label: True damage
effects.desc: Adds flat or scaling damage that bypasses mitigation.

effects.label: Effective damage
effects.desc: Deals effective damage against a foe class.

effects.label: Adaptive damage
effects.desc: Uses the lower of the foe's Def or Res.

effects.label: Damage reduction
effects.desc: Reduces incoming damage, often by a stat difference.

effects.label: Healing
effects.desc: Restores HP to the unit or to allies.

effects.label: Miracle
effects.desc: Survives a lethal hit with 1 HP.

effects.label: Recoil
effects.desc: Deals damage to the unit itself (Fury, Push, ...).

effects.label: Distant Counter
effects.desc: Counterattacks regardless of the foe's range.

effects.label: Refresh
effects.desc: Grants another action to the unit or an ally.

effects.label: Weapon triangle
effects.desc: Grants or inflicts weapon-triangle advantage.

effects.label: Stat scaling
effects.desc: Adds damage or stats based on a percentage of a stat.

effects.label: Bonus Doubler
effects.desc: Grants stats equal to the unit's current visible bonuses.

effects.label: Grand Strategy
effects.desc: Grants stats equal to twice the unit's current penalties.

effects.label: Treachery
effects.desc: Deals additional damage equal to total bonuses on the unit.

effects.label: Dominance
effects.desc: Deals additional damage equal to total penalties on the foe.

effects.label: Resonance
effects.desc: Grants Atk/Spd or Def/Res during combat (Blades / Shields).

effects.label: Liberate
effects.desc: Grants a stat bonus based on the number of Bonus effects in play.

effects.label: Clash
effects.desc: Grants stats based on the distance moved into combat.

effects.label: Incited
effects.desc: Grants stats based on the distance moved when initiating.

effects.label: Great Talent
effects.desc: Raises specified stats until they reach their cap.

effects.label: Phantom stat
effects.desc: Treats a stat as higher for comparison purposes only.

effects.label: Visible buffs
effects.desc: Grants field stat bonuses that show as blue numbers.

effects.label: Visible debuffs
effects.desc: Inflicts field stat penalties that show as red numbers.

effects.label: Flat stat boost
effects.desc: Permanently raises the stat line before combat (Life and Death, ...).

effects.label: In-combat buffs
effects.desc: Grants stats only during combat (Blow, Stance, Solo, ...).

effects.label: In-combat debuffs
effects.desc: Inflicts stats only during combat (Lull, Cantrip, ...).

effects.label: Penalty cleanse
effects.desc: Neutralises penalties on the unit or allies.

effects.label: Bonus negation
effects.desc: Neutralises bonuses on the foe.

targets.label: visible buff scaling
targets.desc: Performance scales with the unit's visible bonuses.

targets.label: penalty scaling
targets.desc: Performance scales with penalties on the unit or the foe.

targets.label: high-cooldown Special
targets.desc: A Special with cooldown 3+ needs help to trigger.

targets.label: stat comparison
targets.desc: The effect hinges on a stat check against the foe.

targets.label: follow-up package
targets.desc: Wants the follow-up plan completed (Desperation, Vantage, Null C, ...).

targets.label: sustain
targets.desc: Damage reduction wants healing to stay relevant.

visible_buff_scaling.rationale: grants visible bonuses that the scaler converts into stats
raises the base stat line the scaler works from
another bonus scaler, so both feed off the same buffs
turns visible bonuses into true damage

penalty_scaling.rationale: applies the penalties this skill scales from
flips the foe's bonuses into penalties
converts the foe's penalties into damage
converts the unit's penalties into stats

high_cooldown_special.rationale: charges the Special on every attack
shaves cooldown so the Special is ready sooner
free cooldown before the first attack
keeps Guard from stalling the cooldown
cooldown control in the same package

stat_comparison.rationale: visible bonuses count toward the check
penalties on the foe swing the comparison

follow_up_control.rationale: lands the follow-up before the counterattack
denies the foe's follow-up in return

sustain.rationale: keeps the tank alive so damage reduction stays relevant
safety net against the lethal hit
blocks chip damage from outside combat
